verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a public REST API that covers all aspects of the platform: projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts and scorers. The API is defined by a published OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec, has a 'Try it' playground on each endpoint page, and is /v1 path-versioned under a stability policy. The probe 404s at www.braintrust.dev paths do not contradict this, since the spec is served from the docs host and GitHub. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation-notice window for the REST API, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
You can use it to: Create and manage projects, experiments, and datasets; Log traces and metrics; Manage prompts, tools, and scorers
The API is defined by an OpenAPI 3.1.1 specification published at braintrust-openapi on GitHub.
